name: seo-geo
title_zh: AI 搜索时代的关键词布局与结构化标记生成器
tagline_zh: ChatGPT、Perplexity 的答案里没你？它同时优化传统 SEO 与 GEO：分析关键词。
tagline_en: Missing from ChatGPT & Perplexity answers? It handles both SEO and GEO: keyword analysis plus schema markup so AI.
desc_en: SEO & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) for websites. Analyze keywords, generate schema markup, optimize for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude) and traditional search (Google, Bing). Use when user wants to improve search visibility.
why_zh: 不是只堆关键词——它把页面改造成 AI 引擎能直接抽取答案的结构，等于给机器读者也写了摘要。
why_en: Not keyword stuffing—it restructures pages so AI engines can extract answers directly, like writing a summary for machine readers.
limit_zh: 只处理公开网页的文本与 schema；不碰站内搜索、不生成内容、不保证排名。需要能访问目标页面的网络环境。
limit_en: Only handles public page text & schema; no site search, content generation, or ranking guarantees. Requires network access to crawl target pages.
title_en: Keyword & schema generator for AI-era search visibility
